title: WSL lookdev witness requires implicit Vulkan/dependency provisioning before a queued build
body: The documented WSL lookdev configure had to auto-provision Vulkan/dependency state before the first queued build; the witness workflow should expose and preflight this setup so a lane does not discover it only when configuring the capture tree.

title: Native CTest helper does not provision ctest.exe on the PowerShell PATH
body: The queued vixen-native.sh ps CTest invocation failed before test discovery because PowerShell did not have ctest.exe on PATH; the witness had to use the installed CMake absolute path. The native test helper should bootstrap the pinned CMake bin path before invoking CTest.

title: Native capture sync ignores uncommitted lane changes
body: tools/vixen-native.sh warns and synchronizes only the committed tip, so a queued native build silently targets stale source until the lane is committed; the witness workflow should either reject before queue admission or expose an explicit committed snapshot step.
